message.content:
This is a liquid foliar fertilizer containing N, P and K, so Chapter 31 is the likely home. Heading 3105 covers mineral or chemical fertilizers containing two or three of the fertilizing elements nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium. Heading 3101 covers products of vegetable or animal origin, including those mixed together or chemically treated, but this product is mainly mineral NPK with organic additives.

Within 3105, subheading 3105.20 covers mineral or chemical fertilizers containing all three elements N, P and K. Its statistical suffix is 3105.20.00 with 10 digits as 3105.20.0000. The product's N+P2O5+K2O total is 6%, which is not high. The 3105.20 subheading has no minimum content, so it applies. The packages are 1-liter containers, below the 10 kg limit for 3105 goods in tablets or similar forms, but a liquid is not in that form anyway. Therefore, 3105.20.0000 is the classification.

Heading 3101 is less suitable because the NPK content comes from urea and phosphoric acid, which are chemical inputs. Heading 3105 is more apt.

{"hts_code": "3105.20.0000", "reason": "Liquid mineral/chemical fertilizer containing the three fertilizing elements nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium (urea and phosphoric acid based) falls under HTSUS 3105.20."}
